events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! From The Pretenders' hits to her enduring influence, what's your favourite track from this rock legend?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering music icon John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul: 61 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Evolution of Sound
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A true game-changer that saw them push musical boundaries. Still sounds fresh today!

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon and peace activist John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of music and peace continues to resonate globally.
